mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.07% is at a historically low level, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 8.5%, it indicates a deteriorating labor market, compressing corporate earnings and predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 8.0% and employment (PAYEMS) falls below 132000.0 (thousands), it indicates a severe labor market contraction, compressing corporate profit margins and predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0% and PAYEMS < 132000.0.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle demand recovery regime, housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) are both above their 2010-2011 baseline levels, indicating strengthening consumer demand and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS are both above 2010-2011 baseline levels.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5% annually, it indicates accelerating inflation, compressing real interest rates and predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The current industrial production index (95.8) is below the 2017 base (100), indicating weak supply conditions that compress corporate profit margins and predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise above 700.0 (thousands), it indicates a strengthening housing market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 700.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is at or below 0.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8.0%, it indicates a policy response to high unemployment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
